test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Anupam started a business with an initial investment of ₹2,00,000. In the first year, he incurred a loss of 4%. However, during the second year, he earned a profit of 10%, and in the third year he earned a profit of 15%. Calculate his net profit for the entire period of three years.
solution: Given Initial investment = ₹2,00,000 Loss in first year = 4% Profit in second year = 10% Profit in third year = 15% Concept: The net change in value after applying percentage changes sequentially is found by adjusting the initial amount by each percentage change in turn. Solution: ⇒ After the first year, the investment becomes ₹2,00,000 × (1 - 0.04) = ₹1,92,000 ⇒ After the second year, the investment becomes ₹1,92,000 × (1 + 0.10) = ₹2,11,200 ⇒ After the third year, the investment becomes ₹2,11,200 × (1 + 0.15) = ₹2,42,880 ⇒ Net profit = Final value - Initial investment = ₹2,42,880 - ₹2,00,000 = ₹42,880 Therefore, the net profit for the entire period of three years is ₹42,880. 1ab:T1445,
